risk.description: Highest current engineering risk supported by an observation.

ship.description: Whether an experienced engineer should approve the implementation as-is.

summary.description: Concrete overall assessment grounded in the prepared source evidence; never a placeholder.

primaryConcern.description: Empty when ship is true; otherwise a short noun phrase naming the primary concern.

observations.description: Zero to four important, actionable engineering observations.

id.description: Stable short identifier within this response.

title.description: Concise engineering concern, not a sentence or placeholder.

severity.description: Current impact if the concern remains.

confidence.description: How directly the cited evidence supports the conclusion.

summary.description: What the implementation does and why it is problematic.

impact.description: Concrete correctness, maintenance, architecture, or operational consequence.

recommendation.description: Specific actionable improvement; never 'no action needed'.

tradeoffs.description: Relevant cost or alternative, or an empty string when none.

evidence.description: Direct source citations that prove the observation.

citationId.description: An exact citation ID from a prepared read_file result.

line.description: A 1-based line within the citation's inclusive startLine and endLine range.

detail.description: How this citation supports the observation.

strengths.description: Zero to three meaningful, evidence-backed strengths.

summary.description: Concrete strength demonstrated by prepared evidence.

evidence.description: Direct source citations supporting the strength.

citationId.description: An exact citation ID from a prepared read_file result.

line.description: A 1-based line within the citation's inclusive startLine and endLine range.

detail.description: How this citation supports the strength.
